description:
Embr is a fast, native Twitch client built for iPhone and iPad — not a wrapped web view. Streams open in a real AVPlayer with picture-in-picture, background audio, and instant quality switching. Chat is rendered natively so it stays smooth even in the busiest channels. No bloat, no clutter, just watch and chat.

Browse without an account. Star the channels you love to keep them one tap away, and sign in with Twitch only when you want your follows and to join the conversation.

WATCH
• Native AVPlayer video — live streams, VODs, and clips
• Picture-in-picture and background audio — keep watching while you use other apps
• Audio-only mode for listening with the screen off
• Quality selection, latency display, and landscape fullscreen with chat beside the stream
• Double-tap to seek, and adjustable playback speed on VODs
• Past broadcasts replay their chat in sync
• A channel's clips play as a vertical feed: swipe to the next one, already loading

REAL-TIME CHAT
• Live chat over Twitch EventSub — fast and reliable
• Animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ, all merged together, with an emote keyboard
• A Chats tab that keeps several chats open without the video, with unread and mention counts — up to three side by side on iPad
• Mentions: everything that mentions you or matches your highlights, from every open chat
• User cards: tap a name for their account age and messages, then mention, highlight, block, or report
• Badges, cheermotes, replies with swipe to reply, emote autocomplete, and recent-message backfill
• Search the chat, mute words, and hide users you'd rather not see
• VoiceOver reads every message aloud, emote names included

FOR MODERATORS
• Moderator Tools: allow or deny AutoMod's held messages, answer unban requests, and read the moderation log
• Delete, time out, and ban from a user card in the channels you moderate

BROWSE & DISCOVER
• Favorites — star any channel and see who's live at a glance, no account needed
• Favorites sync between your iPhone and iPad through iCloud
• Live channels and top categories at a glance
• Search channels and categories instantly
• A Following tab that surfaces who's live (when signed in)

MADE FOR iPhone AND iPad
• Settings laid out like the Settings app, with search
• Light and dark appearance, chat readability and text-scale controls
• Full guest browsing — an account is optional

EMBR STUDIO, FOR STREAMERS
• Your own chat, the next ad break and every follow, sub, raid and hype train on one screen, on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV
• Snooze or run ad breaks, post quick messages, change chat modes and turn on Shield Mode
• Hype trains, polls, predictions and goals live over chat, and a recap after every stream
• A sample stream shows it all before you sign in

SUPPORT EMBR
Watching, chat and browsing never cost anything. Streamers can add Studio Pro (ad controls, alert sounds, stream recaps, moderator mode and quick messages) by the month, by the year or once, and every streamer gets a week of it from their first live stream in Studio. If Embr becomes how you watch, you can leave a tip or become a Founding Supporter: a one-time purchase that unlocks only looks, which you can try on first. Everyone in Embr sees your flame badge, your name in your color and your founding number.

Embr is open source.

———

Embr is an independent, third-party app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected to Twitch Interactive, Inc. "Twitch" and all related names, marks, and logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are used here only to describe what the app connects to. You sign in with your own Twitch account through Twitch's official OAuth; Embr never sees your password. Use of Twitch is subject to Twitch's own Terms of Service.
